summary: Tested new 'Website Content' admin editability feature end-to-end on the preview URL. Backend pytest (7 tests, all pass): public GET /api/settings shape and no _id leak; unauthenticated PUT rejected (401/403); about_portrait rejects external URL and traversal (400); PUT persists new keys (hero_eyebrow, why_aura_p1, share_items, chat_suggestions, contact_topics, bio_paragraphs); server-side caps enforced (chat_suggestions ≤4, contact_topics ≤12); full cleanup restored original state. Frontend end-to-end: admin login → Website Content tab renders all groups prefilled with current live values using UNDERSCORE testids (wc-hero_eyebrow-input, wc-why_aura_title-input, wc-ask_aura_button-input, wc-share-0..5-title/text, wc-chat-suggestion-0..2, wc-bio-input, wc-topics-input); edit + save (content-save-button → content-saved toast) propagates to homepage (hero eyebrow, Why AURA p1, Ask AURA heading/button, What I Share title), AURA chat suggestion chip, and /contact topics dropdown; About page bio update reflects instantly with **bold** ('Abhijit Debnath', 'It's about knowing what matters.') and *italic* ('how can technology create meaningful business outcomes?') formatting preserved. About Profile Image upload (portrait-hero.png via about-portrait-input; about-portrait-staged shown) → after Save Content both /about portrait AND homepage About-teaser portrait switch to /api/media/aura/uploads/articles/*.png; reset to null via curl restores /assets/portrait-cutout.png. SEO fix confirmed: homepage <title> = 'AURA by Abhijit — Technology Leadership for an Intelligent Future.' by default; setting tagline='TEST TAGLINE XYZ' in Settings tab updates <title> to 'AURA by Abhijit — TEST TAGLINE XYZ' and revert restores default. Cross-tab safety verified: saving Settings tab keeps all Website Content keys (hero_eyebrow, share_items, chat_suggestions, bio_paragraphs, contact_topics) intact; saving Website Content keeps hero_portrait/about_portrait echoed. Every test edit was reverted; about_portrait reset to null; final GET /api/settings confirmed originals restored. Mobile 390px viewport shows no horizontal scroll on /, /about, /contact. No JS console errors on any page.
critical_code_review_comments: Persistence side-effect: ContentPanel save writes every field back to DB even when the user hasn't changed anything (prefill echoes DEFAULT_CONTENT). After any Save Content, the DB now stores literal copies of defaults for hero_eyebrow / why_aura_* / ask_aura_* / share_items / chat_suggestions / contact_topics / bio_paragraphs. Site is visually identical (invariant holds because defaults = current copy), but any future change to DEFAULT_CONTENT in code will be silently overridden by the stored copies. Consider: (a) only submit fields that actually differ from DEFAULT_CONTENT, or (b) show a 'Reset to default' button per field that deletes the key from DB.

server.py is now ~1170 lines; clean_settings alone has ~90 lines with many similar dict-list validators — a small clean_string_list / clean_dict_list helper would reduce duplication and it is time to split settings/media/admin into modules per the >700-line guideline.

SettingsPanel + ContentPanel duplicate the About Profile Image / Hero Portrait upload block (nearly identical JSX + file validation). Extracting a <PortraitUploader onFile ... /> component would remove ~50 lines of duplication.

ContentPanel testid convention is inconsistent — top-level scalar fields use underscores (wc-hero_eyebrow-input) matching the setting key, but two textareas use hyphens (wc-why-aura-p1-input, wc-why-aura-p2-input, wc-ask-aura-text-input). Review request lists wc-why_aura_p1-input etc.; current DOM has wc-why-aura-p1-input. Not a defect for our tests (we used the actual DOM testids) but worth aligning.
seed_data_creation: During testing every edit was reverted. Final state: about_portrait=null (reset via curl); hero_portrait=null; content dict contains DEFAULT_CONTENT values for hero_eyebrow/why_aura_*/ask_aura_*/share_items/chat_suggestions/contact_topics/bio_paragraphs (visually identical to before — see code-review note above).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Regression suites for the feature: pytest /app/backend/tests/test_content_editability.py (7 tests) + pytest /app/backend/tests/test_hero_portrait.py (from iteration_2). Both require REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL env var and use -o addopts= to avoid the xdist load-scope race on the shared preview DB. ContentPanel textarea testids for why_aura_p1/p2 and ask_aura_text use HYPHENS (wc-why-aura-p1-input, wc-why-aura-p2-input, wc-ask-aura-text-input); all other Website Content field testids use UNDERSCORES matching the settings keys.
